observation: Existing browser page was downloading again while its earlier extracted cache remained present. No user submission was made by this audit before the observation.

sourceEvidence.oldPolicy: initialize required entry.version === CACHE_VERSION and automatically fetched after a mismatch or failed validation
sourceEvidence.terrainCompatibility: New rock terrain lookup required ruff01.tem; the version 5 extractor selected rough01.tem/rough02.tem instead

limits: This proves a repeated unrequested download after invalidation, not an infinite retry loop within one unchanged page. Versions 7 and 8 came from another concurrent writer. A later browser inspector request timed out, so this artifact makes no claim that the old profile was subsequently revalidated in-browser. Final real-download/reopen end-to-end verification is separate.
